nodes.description: Private mapping (address => uint256) tracking token balances of each holder in ERC20.
Private nested mapping (address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing ERC20 allowances.
Private uint256 total number of tokens in existence.
Private string holding the token name 'Alternate Virtual Equity Credit'.
Private string holding the token symbol 'AVEC'.
Private uint8 holding the token decimals (18).
Public view function returning _totalSupply.

Public view function returning the allowance owner granted to spender.

Public function approving spender to spend tokens on behalf of msg.sender.
Public function moving tokens between accounts using an existing allowance, then decreasing it.
Public function increasing the allowance granted by msg.sender to spender.
Public function decreasing the allowance granted by msg.sender to spender.
Internal function performing the actual balance debits/credits and emitting Transfer.
Internal function creating new tokens and increasing total supply.
Internal function destroying tokens and decreasing total supply.
Internal function writing the allowance mapping and emitting Approval.
Internal function burning tokens from an account and reducing msg.sender's allowance.
Public function burning msg.sender's own tokens.

AVEC constructor setting name/symbol/decimals and minting the initial supply to msg.sender.
Public view function returning the token name.
Public view function returning the token symbol.
Public view function returning the token decimals.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow check.
SafeMath division with division-by-zero check.
SafeMath subtraction with underflow check.
SafeMath addition with overflow check.
SafeMath modulo with modulo-by-zero check.
Caller-controlled address used as the implicit sender/owner in transfers, approvals, burns and the initial mint.
Arithmetic debit of _balances[from] and credit of _balances[to] inside _transfer.
Arithmetic increase of _totalSupply and recipient balance inside _mint.
Arithmetic decrease of _totalSupply and holder balance inside _burn.
Write of the _allowed[owner][spender] allowance value inside _approve.
Arithmetic subtraction of the burnt value from _allowed[account][msg.sender] inside _burnFrom.
Arithmetic evaluation of the initial supply expression 1440000000 * 10 ** 18 in the AVEC constructor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument into the internal _transfer call.
msg.sender is passed as the 'owner' argument into the internal _approve call.
msg.sender is the recipient account in the constructor's _mint call.
msg.sender's address is passed as 'account' into _burn for self-burning.
transfer() delegates the actual balance movement to _transfer().
transferFrom() delegates the actual balance movement to _transfer().
transferFrom() calls _approve() to reduce the spender allowance.
increaseAllowance() writes the new allowance via _approve().
decreaseAllowance() writes the new allowance via _approve().
approve() writes the allowance through _approve().
burn() calls the internal _burn() implementation.
burnFrom() calls the internal _burnFrom() implementation.
_burnFrom() first burns the tokens by calling _burn().
_burnFrom() then reduces the allowance by calling _approve().
AVEC constructor calls _mint() to create the initial token supply.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance, guarding against integer underflow.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance, guarding against integer overflow.
_mint uses SafeMath.add for total supply and balances, guarding against integer overflow.
_burn uses SafeMath.sub for total supply and balances, guarding against integer underflow.
_burnFrom uses SafeMath.sub to decrease the allowance safely.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub to decrease the spender allowance safely.
increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add to increase the allowance safely.
decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub to decrease the allowance safely.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf() reads the _balances mapping.
allowance() reads the nested _allowed mapping.
name() returns the _name state variable.
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable.
decimals() returns the _decimals state variable.
_transfer reads and writes balances in the _balances mapping.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_mint increases the recipient entry of the _balances mapping.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn decreases the account entry of the _balances mapping.
_approve writes the _allowed mapping.
_transfer performs the arithmetic balance debit/credit that constitutes the unsafe operation.
_mint performs the arithmetic total supply and balance increase.
_burn performs the arithmetic total supply and balance decrease.
_approve performs the allowance storage write.
_burnFrom performs the arithmetic allowance subtraction.
The constructor evaluates the initial supply arithmetic expression.
The balance update writes the mutated values back into _balances.
The mint operation writes the increased value into _totalSupply.
The mint operation writes the increased recipient balance into _balances.
The burn operation writes the decreased value into _totalSupply.
The burn operation writes the decreased account balance into _balances.
_approve writes the new allowance value into _allowed.
_burnFrom writes the reduced allowance value into _allowed.
